design.decision: Each set costs one growth step for the rest of the run, so bid what you can make, while the growing ×mult makes every later bid worth more.
design.opponent: Revealed the first time it grows; opponents can only stop it by setting your team.
design.rationale: A Generic run-long ×mult on a broad condition (teams make about 64% of contracts), the shape that worked at common for +mult; it differs from the growth seeds that failed on rare conditions, and the snowball risk is noted because it rewards early grants most.
design.draftText: This sigil gains ×0.15 contract multiplier every time your team makes its contract (currently ×1)

critic.concerns: Differs from ub-make8-grow-x only in the threshold; snowballs from early purchases, and its growth state is a tracked counter.
